operationalSituations.description: Developer runs fusaops check during active development of a mixed-language repository — aggregated findings inform safety-critical code changes across languages
CI/CD pipeline runs fusaops check as a gating check before release — the aggregate exit code determines whether a polyglot build proceeds
Auditor reviews the FuSaOps aggregated multi-language report or dashboard to make certification decisions spanning every language in the system

hazards.description: Dropped finding — FuSaOps loses or hides a finding produced by a bundled x-FuSa tool during normalisation
hazards.source: Parser error swallowing findings, or an unknown severity being discarded instead of normalised

hazards.description: Masked coverage gap — an applicable language tool does not run and FuSaOps reports PASS without surfacing that the language was unchecked
hazards.source: Adapter silently skipped, tool not installed, or detection miss treated as success

hazards.description: Silent failure — fusaops check exits 0 when the aggregate contains ERROR-severity findings
hazards.source: Summary mis-count or exit-code logic returning success despite errors

hazards.description: Misattribution — a finding is attributed to the wrong language or tool, misdirecting triage
hazards.source: Incorrect language/tool tagging during report assembly

hazards.description: Stale evidence — the served dashboard or cached aggregate report no longer reflects the current source under review
hazards.source: Cache not refreshed before an audit or gating decision

safetyGoals.description: FuSaOps shall preserve every finding emitted by a bundled tool, normalising unknown severities to INFO rather than dropping them
safetyGoals.safeState: Surface a decode error as a failed/skipped component rather than an empty pass

safetyGoals.description: FuSaOps shall record every applicable-but-uninstalled or failed tool as an explicit skipped component so coverage gaps are visible
safetyGoals.safeState: Emit a skipped component with reason; never omit an applicable language silently

safetyGoals.description: FuSaOps shall exit non-zero whenever any component produces an ERROR-severity finding, or a WARNING under --strict
FuSaOps shall tag every finding with the originating language and tool so attribution survives aggregation
safetyGoals.safeState: Findings carry language+tool from the producing adapter

safetyGoals.description: FuSaOps shall recompute the aggregate report on demand so a gating or audit decision can be made against current source
safetyGoals.safeState: Provide an explicit refresh that recomputes before serving
